thread:
Maya (product): Hey team - followup from CX calls today. Customers want per-tenant Optimize recommendations: batching/windowing, conversational cache TTLs, and a simple quant safety verdict. They also want an "explainable" summary in Console before applying. Need to decide MVP scope+gates.
Ravi (eng): What's "simple" for quant safety? A boolean or a graded risk?
Lin (ml): Graded is better: SAFE / CAUTION / RISKY. Based on eval delta on a short prompt-set + embedding distance. We can compute an expected quality loss score.
Grace (cs): Customers requested three operational things: 1) one-click preview of impact, 2) audit log of applied changes, 3) ability to opt-out per tenant.
Omar (pm): My MVP proposal: shipping 1) tenant simulator + suggestion export, 2) Console preview with plain-English summary and risk tier, 3) eval-alerts that trigger when quality delta > threshold. Defer auto-tuning of cache/quant to v1.1. Thoughts?
Ravi (eng): Implementation outline: sampler -> offline simulator -> suggestion engine that emits recommended {max_latency_ms, max_batch_tokens, ttl_seconds, quant_advice}. Exportable JSON + a dry-run mode in Console.
Lin (ml): For eval-alert thresholds propose defaults: quality_drop_pct = 3%, embedding_shift_cosine = 0.08, human-concordance_drop = 5 points (on our small calibration set). Make these tenant-configurable.
Maya (product): Customers mentioned SLOs: many target P95 <= 150ms for chat workloads, embeddings can tolerate higher latency. Also cost-savings ask: ~20% baseline. Capture in PRD.
Grace (cs): Pilot constraints: Dedicated tenants only for apply-button in alpha. Hosted apply requires legal review + safety approval. We should include explicit rollback plan.
Omar (pm): Proposed launch gates:
- Eng gate: suggestion engine accuracy >= 85% on historical traffic (measured by simulated cost delta vs actual).
- ML gate: quant-risk classification precision >= 90% on labeled set.
- Ops gate: Console preview + audit + rollback implemented.
Ravi (eng): Example suggestion payload we can export/apply (JSON):
```json
{
  "batching": {"max_latency_ms": 50, "max_batch_tokens": 1024},
  "cache": {"prefix_ttl_seconds": 180, "ttl_suggestion_range": "120-600"},
  "quant": {"decision": "CAUTION", "expected_quality_loss_pct": "1.8"}
}
```
Maya (product): UX requirement: preview line should be short: "Expected ~22% cost savings, P95 +12ms" with link to simulator modal. Also show risk tier and top 3 example prompts affected.
Lin (ml): For the quant checklist in MVP include: baseline eval run, 50-sample targeted prompt check, and an automated diff report. That should be enough to classify SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY.
Grace (cs): I'll own the pilot runbook for customer ops: consent flows, monitoring playbook, rollback checklist. Will share draft by Tue.
Omar (pm): Effort split proposal: simulator + suggestion engine (60%), Console preview + apply (25%), eval-alerts + hooks (15%). Target alpha with 3 pilots in 7 weeks.
Ravi (eng): Dependencies: sampling pipeline (eng-infra), Console UI components (eng-platform), eval metric hooks (eng-ml). I can draft a tech spike and break out infra PRs.
Maya (product): Decision: include cache TTL suggestions as a range in MVP (no auto-tune). Include quant decision + checklist but not automated quant conversion. OK?
Lin (ml): +1. Safer approach.
Grace (cs): +1. Customers want control first.
Omar (pm): Action items:
- Ravi: tech spike + infra PR list (due EOW)
- Lin: labeled set + threshold recommendations (due Wed)
- Grace: pilot runbook draft (due Tue)
- Maya: update PRD acceptance criteria, schedule pilot invites (due Thu)
deploy-bot: Note: roadmap sync Mon 10am PT. PRD link: <https://redwood.internal/prd/optimize-tenant-suggestions> :rocket:
